notes: Descriptions were rewritten, not copied. The 3.18.0 text claimed 'Unlimited bikes free forever' (FREE_TIER_LIMITS.MAX_BIKES is 1), '5 AI diagnostic scans per month' (the limit is 1), and '$4 per month or $36 per year' (the live paywall_v4 offering sells motovault_pro_monthly_v4 at $9.99, motovault_pro_annual_v4 at $79.99 and motovault_lifetime_v4 at $149.99). All three are metadata-accuracy rejection risks under App Review 2.3.1 / 3.1.2.

Exact prices are deliberately not quoted. Localised descriptions are served in every territory the locale covers, so a hard-coded USD figure is wrong in most of them - the same trap that put MXN prices in the es-ES Play listing.
Feature order follows PostHog-validated usage: expenses > maintenance > rides > trips > AI. AI diagnostics are listed last and are not the hero.

en-US.description:
Know exactly what your motorcycle costs you - and never miss a service again.

MotoVault is the complete garage for riders who care about the machine as much as the ride. Track every expense, log every service, record every mile and plan every trip, in one app built for motorcycles, not cars.

--------------------------
WHAT YOU CAN DO
--------------------------

* TRACK EVERY EXPENSE - Every fill-up, every part, every shop visit. See what your bike really costs you per mile, per month, per year. Free and unlimited, always.

* NEVER MISS A SERVICE - Oil changes, chain adjustments, tire swaps, valve checks. Log the work, get reminded before the next interval, and keep the full maintenance history that holds its value at resale. Free and unlimited, always.

* SCAN A RECEIPT INSTEAD OF TYPING - Point your camera at a fuel, parts or workshop receipt. MotoVault reads the amount, the date and the work done, and fills the form in for you.

* MOTOVAULT ON CARPLAY - Start, pause and end a ride from your head unit. Distance, moving time and your next service, in numbers big enough to read at a glance.

* LOG EVERY RIDE - Auto-track distance, time, route and elevation. Build a logbook of every mile you have ridden, and export it as GPX.

* PLAN EVERY TRIP - Map the weekend loop or the bucket-list tour. Save routes, drop waypoints, share them with your group.

* AI MECHANIC - Hear a weird noise? Describe it or snap a photo, and MotoVault walks you through the likely causes and the fixes.

--------------------------
BUILT FOR REAL RIDERS
--------------------------

- 12,000+ motorcycle models in the catalog, backed by the NHTSA database
- Miles or kilometers - your whole garage follows your choice
- Dark-mode-first design, built to be read in a garage
- Your data is yours: private, exportable, never sold
- Designed in detail for riders in the US and Europe

--------------------------
WHO IT'S FOR
--------------------------

- Daily commuters keeping a bike in top shape
- Weekend riders planning the next good road
- Adventure riders tracking long tours
- Home mechanics who do their own wrenching
- Anyone tired of car-first apps that treat motorcycles as an afterthought

--------------------------
FREE AND PRO
--------------------------

MotoVault is free to use, and logging is never metered: one bike, unlimited expense tracking, unlimited service history, unlimited ride recording, plus 3 receipt scans, 1 AI diagnostic and 1 GPX export every month.

MotoVault Pro adds unlimited bikes, unlimited receipt scans, unlimited AI diagnostics, unlimited GPX exports and advanced rider analytics. Choose a monthly plan, an annual plan, or pay once for lifetime access - prices are shown in the app in your local currency.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://motovault.app/privacy
Terms of Service: https://motovault.app/terms

--------------------------

Questions? Feedback? We read every email: hello@motovault.app

de-DE.description:
Wisse genau, was dein Motorrad dich kostet - und verpasse keinen Service mehr.

MotoVault ist die komplette Garage für Fahrer, denen die Maschine so viel bedeutet wie die Fahrt. Erfasse jede Ausgabe, dokumentiere jeden Service, zeichne jeden Kilometer auf und plane jede Tour - in einer App, die für Motorräder gemacht ist, nicht für Autos.

--------------------------
WAS DU DAMIT MACHST
--------------------------

* JEDE AUSGABE ERFASSEN - Jede Tankfüllung, jedes Teil, jeder Werkstattbesuch. Sieh, was dein Motorrad wirklich kostet, pro Kilometer, pro Monat, pro Jahr. Kostenlos und unbegrenzt, immer.

* KEINEN SERVICE MEHR VERPASSEN - Ölwechsel, Kettenpflege, Reifenwechsel, Ventilspiel. Erfasse die Arbeit, werde vor dem nächsten Intervall erinnert und behalte die lückenlose Historie, die beim Wiederverkauf zählt. Kostenlos und unbegrenzt, immer.

* BELEG SCANNEN STATT TIPPEN - Halte die Kamera auf einen Tank-, Teile- oder Werkstattbeleg. MotoVault liest Betrag, Datum und Arbeit und füllt das Formular aus.

* MOTOVAULT AUF CARPLAY - Fahrt starten, pausieren und beenden direkt am Display. Distanz, Fahrzeit und der nächste Service, groß genug für einen kurzen Blick.

* JEDE FAHRT AUFZEICHNEN - Distanz, Zeit, Route und Höhenmeter automatisch mitschreiben. Ein Fahrtenbuch über jeden gefahrenen Kilometer, exportierbar als GPX.

* JEDE TOUR PLANEN - Die Sonntagsrunde oder die große Reise. Routen speichern, Wegpunkte setzen, mit der Gruppe teilen.

* KI-MECHANIKER - Ein seltsames Geräusch? Beschreib es oder fotografiere es, und MotoVault führt dich durch die wahrscheinlichen Ursachen und Lösungen.

--------------------------
FÜR ECHTE FAHRER GEMACHT
--------------------------

- Über 12.000 Motorradmodelle im Katalog
- Meilen oder Kilometer - deine ganze Garage folgt deiner Wahl
- Dunkles Design, gemacht für die Garage
- Deine Daten gehören dir: privat, exportierbar, niemals verkauft
- Im Detail für Fahrer in Europa und den USA entworfen

--------------------------
FÜR WEN
--------------------------

- Pendler, die ihr Motorrad in Form halten
- Wochenendfahrer auf der Suche nach der nächsten guten Strecke
- Reiseenduristen auf langen Touren
- Schrauber, die selbst Hand anlegen
- Alle, die keine Auto-Apps mehr wollen, in denen Motorräder nur Beiwerk sind

--------------------------
KOSTENLOS UND PRO
--------------------------

MotoVault ist kostenlos nutzbar, und das Erfassen wird nie begrenzt: ein Motorrad, unbegrenzte Ausgaben, unbegrenzte Servicehistorie, unbegrenzte Fahrtenaufzeichnung, dazu 3 Beleg-Scans, 1 KI-Diagnose und 1 GPX-Export pro Monat.

MotoVault Pro ergänzt unbegrenzt viele Motorräder, unbegrenzte Beleg-Scans, unbegrenzte KI-Diagnosen, unbegrenzte GPX-Exporte und erweiterte Auswertungen. Monatlich, jährlich oder einmalig für immer - die Preise siehst du in der App in deiner Währung.

Abos verlängern sich automatisch, wenn sie nicht mindestens 24 Stunden vor Ende der laufenden Periode gekündigt werden. Verwalten oder kündigen jederzeit in den Einstellungen deines App-Store-Accounts.

* PRÉPARER CHAQUE VOYAGE - La boucle du dimanche ou le grand voyage. Enregistrez des itinéraires, posez des points de passage, partagez avec le groupe.

* MÉCANO IA - Un bruit étrange ? Décrivez-le ou photographiez-le, et MotoVault vous guide vers les causes probables et les solutions.

PENSÉ POUR LES VRAIS MOTARDS
--------------------------

- Plus de 12 000 modèles de motos au catalogue

- Un design sombre, conçu pour être lu dans un garage

--------------------------

- Les navetteurs qui veulent une moto au point

- Les voyageurs au long cours
- Les mécanos du dimanche qui font tout eux-mêmes

GRATUIT ET PRO
--------------------------

MotoVault est gratuit, et la saisie n'est jamais limitée : une moto, dépenses illimitées, historique d'entretien illimité, enregistrement de trajets illimité, plus 3 scans de reçus, 1 diagnostic IA et 1 export GPX par mois.

Confidentialité : https://motovault.app/privacy
Conditions d'utilisation : https://motovault.app/terms

Des questions ? Un avis ? Nous lisons chaque e-mail : hello@motovault.app

reviewDetail.notes:
MotoVault is a motorcycle ownership app: expense tracking, maintenance history and reminders, ride recording and trip planning.

DEMO ACCOUNT
Sign in with the email and password above on the Sign In screen. The account already has a motorcycle in the garage with logged expenses and a maintenance history, so every screen has real data.

WHAT IS NEW IN 3.19.1

1) CARPLAY
This build adds a CarPlay Driving Task scene. The com.apple.developer.carplay-driving-task entitlement was granted by Apple under case ID 20710293.

How to test in the simulator: launch MotoVault on the phone and sign in first, then in Simulator choose I/O > External Displays > CarPlay. The MotoVault icon appears on the CarPlay home screen.

The CarPlay scene is a single information panel. It shows Start, Pause, Resume and End Ride actions, live distance and moving time, and the bike's next due service. Ending a ride asks for confirmation (Keep Riding / End Ride). There is no text entry, no map interaction and no video on the CarPlay screen - it is a glanceable ride control surface only.

Location: recording a ride needs location while the app is backgrounded or the screen is off, which is why the app asks for Always location. Recording is always user-initiated - nothing is tracked until the rider taps Start, and the rider can end it at any time from either the phone or CarPlay.

2) RECEIPT SCANNING
Garage tab > open the bike > Expenses > the camera button. Point the camera at any fuel, parts or workshop receipt; a printed receipt or a photo of one both work. The image goes to our backend, is read by an AI model, and the amount, date, vendor and work done are pre-filled into the expense form for the rider to confirm before saving. Nothing is saved without confirmation.
Free accounts get 3 scans per calendar month; Pro is unlimited. Manual entry is free and unlimited on every tier.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
MotoVault Pro is a monthly or annual auto-renewing subscription, plus a one-time lifetime purchase, sold through StoreKit and managed with RevenueCat. The paywall is reachable from Profile > MotoVault Pro and from any Pro-gated feature. The free tier is fully usable without paying: one bike, unlimited expense logging, unlimited maintenance history and unlimited ride recording.

CONTACT
support@motovault.app - we reply within one business day.
